connections.edgeLabel: The classified report was produced inside the ministry ten days after his public 'no explanation'
connections.label: Brigadeiro Octávio Júlio Moreira Lima
connections.note: Moreira Lima told the press on 23 May 1986 that the armed forces had no technical explanation; the Air Defence Command's CONFIDENCIAL Relatório de Ocorrências, dated 10 days later on 2 June 1986, recorded internally that the phenomena were solid and reflected a form of intelligence, and was not released until 25 September 2009. Tier 2 because the two facts are separately sourced and the report is addressed to the Comandante-Geral do Ar rather than to the minister personally; no document obtained in this pass shows the report reaching his desk. What the pairing establishes is the gap between the public formulation and the contemporaneous classified one, inside the same ministry.

desc: An eight-page document on Ministério da Aeronáutica letterhead, stamped CONFIDENCIAL on every page, addressed by the Commander of the Air Defence Air Command to the Commander General of the Air, dated Brasília-DF, 2 June 1986, signed by Brigadeiro do Ar José Pessoa Cavalcanti de Albuquerque as acting commander COMDA/NuCOMDABRA, and annexed with a Relatório de Ocorrências. It is scanned and served publicly by the Brazilian National Archives under reference BR_DFANBSB_ARX_0_0_0249 and was declassified on 25 September 2009, twenty-three years after the minister of aeronautics promised a full dossier within thirty days. Its section IV, Considerações Finais, is the operative text: it lists six behavioural characteristics observed and then states the Command's own opinion that the phenomena are solid and reflect a form of intelligence. It also praises the response posture, noting that each engaged air unit maintained an alert aircraft at 45 minutes' readiness and that within under thirty minutes of activation armed vectors were available. It is a document in which a national air defence command tells its own chain of command, in writing and under classification, that it has tracked solid, intelligently behaving unidentified objects that outran supersonic interceptors.

timeline.label: Brazilian Air Defence Command records solid, intelligent objects
timeline.text: Brigadier José Pessoa Cavalcanti de Albuquerque signs a CONFIDENCIAL Relatório de Ocorrências concluding that 'the phenomena are solid and reflect in a certain manner intelligence, by the capacity to follow and to maintain distance from observers as well as to fly in formation, not necessarily crewed'. It stays classified for twenty-three years.
